source_caption:
📺 Diarra from Detroit (2024–Present)

Diarra from Detroit follows Diarra Brickland, a sharp-witted Detroit schoolteacher going through a difficult divorce who decides to give online dating a chance. After experiencing an unexpectedly wonderful date with a mysterious man named Chris, Diarra becomes suspicious when he suddenly disappears without explanation. Convinced that she hasn’t simply been ghosted, she launches her own investigation, which unexpectedly leads her into a decades-old mystery connected to Detroit’s criminal underworld. With the help of her close friends and several unlikely allies, Diarra finds herself navigating dangerous situations, bizarre encounters, hidden secrets, and hilarious misunderstandings while attempting to uncover the truth. Meanwhile, she struggles to rebuild her personal life and rediscover her independence. Starring Diarra Kilpatrick, Morris Chestnut, Phylicia Rashad, and Bryan Terrell Clark, the series brilliantly combines dark comedy, suspense, and mystery while exploring friendship, heartbreak, identity, resilience, and the unpredictable journey of starting over.

🎭 Genre: Dark Comedy • Mystery • Crime • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 45 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Diarra Kilpatrick

📍 Setting: Detroit, Michigan

📺 Where to Watch: BET+ (United States)

source_details.title: Diarra from Detroit
source_details.synopsis: Diarra from Detroit is an American mystery dark comedy drama television series created by Diarra Kilpatrick and executive produced by Kilpatrick and Kenya Barris. The series stars Kilpatrick as a divorced schoolteacher who believes that she has been ghosted by her rebound Tinder date. Her search for the missing man pulls her into an old mystery involving the Detroit underworld. The series premiered at the 2023 Tribeca Film Festival on June 14, 2023. It premiered on March 21, 2024, on BET+ to positive reviews from critics. In April 2025, the series was renewed for a second season, which premieres on July 29, 2026 on Paramount+, following BET+'s shutdown the prior June.
